subject: op-spd
title: (R)OP.SPD.------ POL.P.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-43 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two) following Braxton's distinction between collective forces and controlling forces of western culture: 'the difference between the concept of collective forces as opposed to controlling forces would have to do with the option spread that is available to white people … but the real controlling factors which really determine American — and western — policy are quite separate from this option spread.' (R)OP-SPD (the reality of option-spread) is crossed with POL-P (political policies): the question is what option-spread produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with political-policies — the (R) prefix marking that this is the actual option-spread available, not the marketed one. The main line runs from (R)OP-SPD up to POL-P at the upper-center. PART (participation) branches from the main line; from PART come DYM-F (dynamic functionalism), which carries DEC (decentralization) on the upper-right margin, and C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism), which carries MT-INFO (multi-information). A vertical from the main line runs down to SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics), which carries VT-DY (vibrational dynamics); EXP-CONT (expansion condition) hangs from VT-DY at the lower-left. The diagram exposes Braxton's structural diagnostic of the option-spread illusion: the productive output (composite-focused-activism, dynamic-functionalism, decentralization) routes through participation.
